decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - Construction details of the new front entrance porch including height, materials and the new stained glass window at scale 1:20 be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Authority before the commence of works.
(Reason: In order that the approved works are carried out in a satisfactory manner which safeguards the character or appearance of the conservation area).
Condition : 4 - Details of the new lancet windows to include materials at scale 1:20 be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Authority before the commence of works.

Condition : 5 - Sample panels of facing Kentish Rag Stone, Random Rubble, showing the proposed colour, texture, face-bond and pointing shall be provided on site and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the works are commenced and the ample panels shall be retained on site until the work is completed and has been approved.
(Reason: In order that the approved works are carried out in a satisfactory manner which safeguards the character or appearance of the conservation area).

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until samples of the facing stone to be used on the string courses, copping, and quoins in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with approved details.
(Reason: In order that the Council may be satisfied as to the details of the development in the interests of visual amenity of the conservation area).

Condition : 7 - Details of the new rooflights be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Authority before the commence of works.
(Reason: In order that the approved works are carried out in a satisfactory manner which safeguards the character or appearance of the conservation area).
description: Erection of single storey front extension incorporating new entrance to existing church
